what: Does reading edge labels change S5? No - and the reason is the metric, not the module.
design: Same recogniser, same code, one flag. src.assemble.s5 --edge-text on and off, val and test.
cause: src.assemble.irdiff builds edge edits as set differences over endpoint keys - edits['edge_insert'] = predicted_edges - true_edges and the mirror for delete. There is no edge_substitute edit kind, so an edge's label is never compared. A state machine with every trigger correct scores identically to one with none.
consequence: S5 is an incomplete proxy for IR correctness on state machines. Edge labels are worth nothing to it and everything to the emitted program: with no triggers every transition is an epsilon transition and epsilon-closure collapses the machine to one state. The stage is therefore wired into src/pipeline/vision.py, where 13.10 measures behaviour.

edge_label_reading_itself.measured_on: 10 fa_bresler pages, 83 annotated triggers, ground-truth polylines
edge_label_reading_itself.note: with a recogniser that never trained on edge-box crops; see textcrops.EDGE_BOX_WIDTHS
